title: Why Review Works
introduction: این مطلب درباره یک روش ساده برای به خاطر سپردن واژه‌هاست. به کلمات first, again و later توجه کن.
paragraphs: When you learn a new English word, you may remember it for a short time. But if you do not use it again, you can forget it.
Review helps your memory. Instead of studying the same list for one hour, try to review a few words several times during the week.
For example, learn five words on Monday. Review them on Tuesday, use them in sentences on Thursday, and test yourself on Saturday.
You can also write a short note or say each word aloud. Small reviews take only a few minutes, but they help you remember more.
